correctness.rationale: The adjacent-transposition Cayley graph of S4 has 24 graph vertices and 36 edges; a face is any graph-edge subset extendible to a perfect matching. Independently enumerated 169 distinct perfect matchings and all 379,056 face masks, obtaining the asserted 12-entry f-vector. Reconstructed the source's ascending-edge toggle discrete-Morse matching: exactly 189,500 face/coface pairs; remaining 10 dimension-three, 40 dimension-four and 6 dimension-five critical augmented cells. Verified all 2,550,660 oriented Hasse incidences give an acyclic directed graph, and independently reconstructed signed Morse chain reductions: D4 is 10×40, D5 is 40×6, D4D5=0. Exact Bareiss computation of specified minors gave det(D4[all rows;cols (0,3,4,6,7,16,20,24,32,37)])=+1 and det(D5[rows (0,5,8,9,19);cols(1,2,3,4,5)])=-1, so both images primitive and ranks 10 and 5. The CW model starts in dimension three, so pi3 of wedge S3 is integer degree lattice; after elementary unimodular cell cancellations, pi4 of wedge S4 is also degree lattice. Hence full integral homotopy wedge 25 S4 plus one S5 (not just field homology), pure dimension 11 and not shellable.
